meta.title: Support for EU membership
meta.question: Do Poles support their country's membership of the European Union?
meta.measure: Supporters of EU membership, % of those with a view
meta.anchor: Read on the scale of CBOS's question "Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (since 2004: membership of) the European Union?", in its face-to-face surveys up to 2020.

items.wording: Is your impression of the European Community/Union generally positive, neutral or negative?
items.notes: Central and Eastern Eurobarometer; the only item in 1990 and 1993-94. Neutral answers are left out.

items.wording: Would you be for or against Poland becoming a member of the European Community?
Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (from 2004: membership of) the European Union?
items.notes: The anchor: the trend is read on this question's scale. Face-to-face surveys up to April 2020. CBOS 'Trendy' series.

items.wording: Should Poland unite with the European Union or keep its independence?
If there were a referendum tomorrow on Poland's membership of the EU, would you vote for or against?
If a referendum on joining the EU were held today, would you vote for or against?
Generally speaking, do you think that Poland's membership of the EU is a good thing, a bad thing, or neither?
items.notes: Standard and European Parliament Eurobarometers. 'Neither' is left out.

items.wording: In a referendum on whether Poland should remain in the EU, would you vote to remain or to leave?
Poland could better face the future outside the EU (agree or disagree)
In a referendum tomorrow, would you vote for Poland to remain a member of the EU or to leave?
Should Poland remain in or leave the EU?
If there were a referendum on Poland's EU membership, would you vote to remain or to leave?
How would you vote in a referendum on Poland's EU membership?
items.notes: Several pollsters (IBRiS, Kantar, OGB, Opinia24, SW Research, United Surveys).

items.wording: Would Poland develop better inside or outside the EU?
Membership support on a four-point scale
As CBOS_memb_support, in CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI and CAWI) from May 2020
items.notes: Same question; a separate level allows for the change of mode (APiW 359 onwards).

Should Poland remain in or leave the EU? (four-point scale)
Do you approve of Poland's EU membership?

Approval of EU membership (wording as reported on Wikipedia)
